# @sokpheak/sp-laravel-api: quick guide for AI assistants

> A typed client for APIs served by the Laravel package `sopheak/sp-laravel-api`. Read this first, then the README for detail.

## 1. What it is

- A TypeScript client that works **only** with a host running `sopheak/sp-laravel-api` (`^0.5.06`; hosts older than 0.5.06 need `createApi({ quoting: false })`).
- It gives you: typed table CRUD (`api.table()`), a query builder that serialises filters for you, pages and `iterate`, one error type (`SpApiError`), and feature modules as subpath imports.
- Runs in browsers, Node >= 20, Deno, Bun and edge runtimes. ESM and CJS. No framework code. Plain functions, no classes to extend.
- Detailed docs: `README.md` (in this package) and one README per module on GitHub under `src/<module>/README.md` (`https://github.com/sopheaksem9999/sp-laravel-api-js`); the module READMEs are not in the npm tarball.

## 2. Install and first call

```bash
npm install @sokpheak/sp-laravel-api
```

```ts
// typecheck
import { createApi } from '@sokpheak/sp-laravel-api';

interface Invoice { id: number; ref_number: string; total: number; status: string }

const client = createApi({
  baseUrl: 'https://api.example.com/api/v2', // origin + the host's api_prefix
  auth: { getHeaders: async () => ({ Authorization: 'Bearer <token>' }) },
  tenant: { header: 'X-Company-ID', value: () => 5 },
});
const items = client.table<Invoice>('invoices');
const page = await items.list({ where: { status: 'open' }, perPage: 20 });
console.log(page.data.length, page.next);
```

`createApi` options you will meet: `baseUrl`, `auth`, `tenant`, `rpcPrefix` (default `'rpc'`), `defaults` (`perPage`, `total`), `fetch`, `timeoutMs`, `retry`, `quoting`, `treatSuccessFalseAsError`, `logger`, `debug`. Everything else is per call.

## 3. Feature map

| You need | Use | Import from |
|---|---|---|
| Create, read, update, delete rows | `api.table<T>(name)`: `list`, `get`, `create`, `update`, `patch`, `remove`, `restore`, `upsert`, `iterate`, `aggregate`, `cursorPagination` | `@sokpheak/sp-laravel-api` |
| Filters, sorting, selects | the `Query` object; `serializeQuery`; `serializeFilters` (filters without paging) | `@sokpheak/sp-laravel-api` |
| A custom host route | `api.rpc(path, opts)` and `api.fn(table, name, opts)` | `@sokpheak/sp-laravel-api` |
| Errors | `SpApiError`, `isSpApiError` | `@sokpheak/sp-laravel-api` |
| Many rows in one call | `bulk(table)`: `create`, `update`, `delete`, `upsert`, `mixed` | `@sokpheak/sp-laravel-api/bulk` |
| Files | `attachments(api)`: `upload`, `uploadDirect`, `uploadMultipart`, `viewBytes`, `viewUrl`, `forRecord`, `folders` | `@sokpheak/sp-laravel-api/attachments` |
| Audit trail | `audit(api)`: `list`, `stats`, `fieldTimeline`, `fieldStats` | `@sokpheak/sp-laravel-api/audit` |
| Roles and permissions | `permissions(api)` | `@sokpheak/sp-laravel-api/permissions` |
| Outgoing webhooks | `webhooks(api)` | `@sokpheak/sp-laravel-api/webhooks` |
| Live changes | `realtime(api)`, `subscribeTenant(echo, api, opts)` (bring your own Echo or Pusher client) | `@sokpheak/sp-laravel-api/realtime` |
| The host's OpenAPI and agent contract | `docs(api)`: `openapi`, `llms`; `capabilities` | `@sokpheak/sp-laravel-api/docs` |
| Request logs for debugging | `createLogger({ sink })` | `@sokpheak/sp-laravel-api/logging` |
| Row types from the host | CLI `npx sp-laravel-api typegen --url <openapi.json> --out src/types/sp-api.ts` | (CLI) |

## 4. Recipes

Filters and paging:

```ts
// typecheck
const rows = await invoices.list({
  select: ['id', 'ref_number', { customer: ['id', 'display_name'] }],
  where: { status: { in: ['open', 'paid'] }, total: { gte: 100 } },
  sort: { by: 'created_at', order: 'desc' },
  cursor: null, // first cursor page; page.next is the next cursor, null at the end
  perPage: 50,
});
for await (const row of invoices.iterate({ where: { status: 'open' } })) console.log(row.id);
console.log(rows.next);
```

Create, update, delete:

```ts
// typecheck
const created = await invoices.create({ ref_number: 'INV-1', total: 120 });
await invoices.update(created.id, { total: 130 });
await invoices.remove(created.id);
```

A custom route (`GET rpc/reports/summary?year=2026`):

```ts
// typecheck
const summary = await api.rpc<{ total: number }>('reports/summary', { query: { year: 2026 } });
console.log(summary.total);
```

Errors:

```ts
// typecheck
import { isSpApiError } from '@sokpheak/sp-laravel-api';

try {
  await invoices.create({ total: -1 });
} catch (e) {
  if (!isSpApiError(e)) throw e;
  if (e.code === 'validation') console.log(e.fieldErrors); // { total: ['...'] }
  else if (e.isTransport) console.log(e.code); // 'network' or 'timeout'; the cause is on e.cause
  else console.log(e.status, e.code, e.errorCode, e.requestId, e.retryAfter);
}
```

Error `code` is one of: `unauthenticated`, `forbidden`, `not_found`, `validation`, `tenant_required`, `module_disabled`, `not_configured`, `unencodable_value`, `rate_limited`, `server`, `network`, `timeout`, `unknown`.

Uploads (the form upload is the default; resize and `asTemp` need it):

```ts
// typecheck
import { attachments } from '@sokpheak/sp-laravel-api/attachments';

const files = attachments(api);
const avatar = await files.upload(file, { width: 512, visibility: 'public' });
await files.upload(file, { recordType: 'products', recordId: 7, collection: 'gallery', replaceOld: true });
const temp = await files.upload(file, { visibility: 'temp_private', tempTimeoutMinutes: 60 });
const bytes = await files.viewBytes(avatar.id); // authenticated fetch of the file
console.log(temp.id, bytes.byteLength);
```

Filters for a host that does its own paging:

```ts
// typecheck
import { serializeFilters } from '@sokpheak/sp-laravel-api';

const params = serializeFilters({ where: { name: { like: 'Smith, John (Jr)' } } }, { quoting: true });
console.log(params.toString()); // no per_page, page, cursor or total
```

Live changes with Laravel Echo:

```ts
// typecheck
import { subscribeTenant } from '@sokpheak/sp-laravel-api/realtime';

declare const echo: Parameters<typeof subscribeTenant>[0];
const stop = subscribeTenant(echo, api, {
  tenantId: 5,
  tables: ['invoices'],
  onChange: (c) => console.log(c.table, c.action, c.record),
  onUnhandled: (e) => console.log(e.eventName, e.payload), // anything that is not a record event
});
stop();
```

## 5. Defaults that bite

- A 2xx response whose JSON body is `{ success: false }` **throws** `SpApiError` (status stays 2xx). Set `treatSuccessFalseAsError: false` to get the body back as data instead.
- `lastPage()` needs a `sort`; without one it throws `unencodable_value` (the host's default sort depends on the table).
- `per_page` is always sent on list calls (default 25). `cursor: null` or `''` sends `cursor=0`. A page's `next` is set only when the page is full.
- Retries are off by default and, when on, apply to GET and HEAD only unless a call passes `retry: true`.
- Ids and names that go into a URL path are guarded: an empty, `.` or `..` value throws `unencodable_value` and sends nothing.
- A 404 is `module_disabled` only on calls with no lookup target; elsewhere it is `not_found`.
- When the server would silently ignore or override an upload option, the client throws `unencodable_value` first (for example `asTemp: true` with a `private` visibility, a timeout on a non-temporary upload, `replaceOld` without `recordType` and `recordId`, `sizeName` with `width`).
- A hand-set `Content-Type` on a `FormData` body is dropped so the runtime can add the multipart boundary.
- The `fetch` option must not add auth headers (the direct-to-storage upload uses it too); use `auth`.
- Logging is off by default and redacts by key name only, so it is not a guarantee against leaking a secret.

## 6. Rules for assistants

- Import from the subpath that owns the feature (`@sokpheak/sp-laravel-api/attachments`, not the root).
- Do not invent options. Check the type in the package's `.d.ts` files (`dist/`) or the module README on GitHub before you use one.
- Use neutral example names (`Acme`, `example.com`, `invoices`, `orders`); never put a real client name in code, tests or docs.
- Pass auth through `createApi({ auth })`; never put a token in a URL or in `fetch` wrappers.
- Do not copy server limits into client code (width and height range, title length, timeout cap): the host's 422 reports them.
